{{Top|leg}}
'''Atmospheric fighters''' were medium-sized combat aerial vehicles. The [[Merr-Sonn Munitions, Inc./Legends|Merr-Sonn]] [[PLX-2M portable missile launcher]] was designed to destroy enemy atmospheric fighters, as well as [[Airspeeder/Legends|airspeeders]] and other medium-sized vehicles.<ref name="EGWT">''[[The Essential Guide to Weapons and Technology]]''</ref>
